bstocks.name: BaseStocks
bstocks.short_description: Stocks on Base: prices, watchlists, portfolios and wallet links. For eligible persons outside the United States.
bstocks.description: Your BaseStocks market desk in Telegram. Browse live stock data, save a private watchlist, read public wallet holdings and activity, explore news, Earn and gift pools, or build a recurring plan link. Tap Start, then Menu. Every transaction is reviewed and signed in your own wallet. Coinbase Tokenized Stocks are offered only to eligible persons outside the United States.

launchpad.name: BaseStocks Launchpad
launchpad.short_description: Discover stock-paired community tokens on Base. Check prices, holders and the current launch fee.
launchpad.description: Explore BaseStocks Launchpad tokens by volume or launch time, search by name, and inspect a token's current fee before opening it in your wallet. Pools charge a declining launch fee during their first twenty seconds. Community tokens are a separate product with separate risks. This bot never holds funds or signs transactions.
